judge.voice: I liked that the help was right there on the screen and Mia spoke slowly, so I never felt rushed. The correction about "tomatoes are red" was clear, and I could see my own words quoted. That is respectful. But the phrase help confused me. It talked about "maths and art", which Mia never said, and it told me my answer "I like the garden" had a different purpose, when she asked what I like. That I do not trust. The cue did not give me words for Sunday; I made up "Mia, school good?" myself. At the end she asked a new question and I simply finished, nobody asked me to try. For fifteen minutes on Saturday it could replace the tram to the library if the help matched the conversation. Now, děkuji, only partly. I would try it once more.
